summary.text: Tara Johnson is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 96 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
She is the executive director of the United Way of La Crosse and a former La Crosse County Board chair.

paragraphs.text: Tara Johnson's career experience includes working as executive director of the United Way of La Crosse.
She served as a La Crosse County board member and chair and was a member of AFSCME.
Johnson took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Republican Loren Oldenburg in District 96, and serves on the Agriculture Committee.
